2023-4289-4770-5434.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4499-4506-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

147-8095-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-8095-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-8095-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4019-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4019-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-864-2034-2279-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2034-2279-3125.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

864-1987-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
864-1987-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
864-1987-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

849-2946-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
849-2946-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-4885-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4885-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

140-2935-7433.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

80-1618-2440-5997.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa
80-1618-2440-5997.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-1618-2440-5997.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

206-2085-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

290-1978-7290.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Does Machines.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2302-2773-3490-4369.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-2302-2773-3490-4369.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5003-7205.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kithkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
When Kithkeeper dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Kithkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Kithkeeper enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1409-2397-4716.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve both Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4779-6972-7153.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

225-539-2908-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
225-539-2908-6745.description:
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Repeat.
225-539-2908-6745.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

1115-3490-4289-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1115-3490-4289-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

3773-6798-6972--112.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
3773-6798-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

3652-4050-5220-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1350-2793-4659-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3525-5268-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

3372-4865-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter
3372-4865-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Vesuvan Shapeshifter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Shapeshifter's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Vesuvan Shapeshifter's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Vesuvan Shapeshifter's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

157-1343-2686.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Kaervek's Spite by paying {B}{B}{B}, discarding your hand, and sacrificing all permanents.
When Detention Sphere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Barren Glory from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve Kaervek's Spite, causing target player to lose 5 life.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

411-5963.description:
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Activate Marvin using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {R} and returning Marvin from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

974-1636-2157.notablePrerequisites:
Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-1636-2157.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
When Smaug enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Intruder Alarm and the Smaug token that died trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 4.

2584-4133-5231.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Soul Collector, adding {R}.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-3263-3480-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
3259-3263-3480-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-3480-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

891-2523-5256-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2523-5256-5515.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Boonweaver Giant's power.
Repeat.

4559-4659-4871-5272.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have a combined mana value of ten or greater.
4559-4659-4871-5272.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metlwork Colossus dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Farid trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Farid trigger, creating a Scrap artifact token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasure token and the Scrap token, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.
